feeding_claim.verbatim: Our grass–finished cows remain on the pasture to graze on their natural grass diet

resold_note: Also sells bison, pork, eggs and beef jerky without saying they are raised on the ranch.
notes: Kauai east side ranch, more than 500 head on 1,326 acres; shop at 887F Kamalu Road, Kapaa (address left private pending Verifier check that it is the farm's own shop). Single-page site: read home, about, where to buy, pre-order and find us sections. Says all products are grass-finished and contrasts this with grass-fed. Pre-order form needs 24 hours notice, for pickup (Mon to Fri, business hours) or delivery; site says it distributes island-wide but names no delivery area. Sold at Wailua Country Store, Papaya's Natural Foods, Hoku Foods, Healthy Hut and Natural Pet, and in Kauai restaurants. Lamb is in the site headline (pasture raised, grass finished beef and lamb) but not clearly stated as its own; Verifier should confirm lamb. Quote contains an en dash as on the site.
